items.title: Tom McIntosh — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: my love for Gene Autry, who was always next to…he had a love of Mexico. I was drawn to the Mexican musical experience.

ctx.x: I wanted to ask you something else about your Army days, because I think it was when you were in the Army that you first heard Charlie Parker. Is that true? When the Army—when somebody played Charlie Parker for you?
Oh, yeah. This is Ernest Outlaw, a very important part of my growth. Sadly, when I went to the Army, my favorite musician was Gene Autry.
